name: Edit company basic information
description: Update the organization’s core company details from the Admin module and save the changes.

name: Configure company structure
description: Define departments, organizational units, and other company structure settings.

name: Manage job titles and job descriptions
description: Create or update job titles and their associated descriptions for the organization.

name: Set up pay grades
description: Define pay grade levels used in the HR system.

name: Manage user access rights and roles
description: Create and assign roles or permissions to control what users can access in the system.

name: Configure security settings
description: Adjust system security-related settings that affect administrative access and control.

name: Manage skills and qualifications
description: Add and maintain skills and qualification records used in HR profiles.

name: Set up customer and project records
description: Create and maintain customer and project entries in the Admin module.

name: Maintain employee contact and emergency information
description: View or edit contact details, emergency contacts, and dependent information for employees.

name: Manage employee immigration records
description: Add and update immigration information and documents for employees.
